title.en: Hanechin to Bucky no Oko-sama Shinryouroku

altTitles.ja: ハネチンとブッキーのお子さま診療録

description.en: Haneda is an office worker who has become a single father after the death of his wife. He was suddenly left to raise his two children on his own, and he spent his days being pushed around by his children's every move, which he could not understand. One day, his son falls ill on a train and is saved by Kotobuki, a young pediatrician wearing devilish makeup.
description.ja: 妻を亡くし、突然二人の子供を育てることになったサラリーマン・羽根田は理解不能な子供の言動に途方に暮れる毎日を送っていた。ある日、電車内で体調を崩した羽根田の息子を救ったのは異様なメイクを施した強面の若者・琴吹。彼は的確な処置で急病の原因を突き止めるが・・・。
description.vi: Sau khi vợ mất, anh nhân viên văn phòng kiêm người cha đơn thân Haneda, đã phải một mình vật lộn nuôi 2 đứa con thơ. Vào một lần con trai anh ngã bệnh ở trên tàu điện ngầm, anh đã được một bác sĩ nhi kì lạ giúp đỡ...

biography.en:
Known as YUMEKA Sumomo (**夢花李**) in the **BL** community, but has also published under the names SAHARA Mizu (**佐原 ミズ**) for her **seinen** works, SAHARA Keita (**佐原恵太**) for her **shoujo** works and Chikyuya/Sasshi (**地球屋/さっし**) for **doujinshi**.

In her epilogues, she often describes herself as not satisfied with what she has done but is grateful to the people she works with. She is rumored to be a layout artist for Studio Ghibli.
